name: Broiler drawer
description: The shallow sheet-steel drawer from under an electric oven.
notes: An open sheet-steel tray 660 by 440 mm with runner lips and an enamelled front with a finger pull. The tray walls are thin, so the box is about twice the reference's 20 L. Salvaging it into sheet metal has no content field yet.

name: Stripped oven cabinet
description: The bare steel body of an electric oven, with its door, controls and drawer removed.
notes: A white shell round a dark enamelled cavity with rack ridges, an empty control bay above with three cut wires, and an empty drawer bay below. Dismantling it into sheet metal has no content field yet. The size is a placeholder for a thing too bulky for a pack.

name: Oven control panel
description: An oven's control strip with four knobs, a small display and its circuit board.
notes: Glass fascia over a steel backing, green display, four knobs, a circuit board on the back and three cut wires. CHECK VOLUME (x3.1): the knobs and the wires trailing behind deepen the box; the panel alone is about the reference's 2 L. Salvaging the board has no content field yet.

name: Oven door
description: A steel oven door with a glass window, its handle and hinge arms still attached.
notes: Laid face up with its top edge toward +z, so the iso tile shows the window and handle; the hinge arms stick out of the bottom edge. The box is about twice the reference's 20 L because the handle stands proud of the face. glass-grey draws the double glazing.

name: Stripped stovetop
description: The enamelled top of an electric range with its coils removed. The drip bowls, terminal blocks and wiring remain.
notes: Four chrome drip bowls, two large and two small, each with a ceramic terminal block where its coil plugged in, and four cut wires out the back. enamel-white reads light grey in the tile.

name: Bottle of hair dye
description: A squeeze bottle of permanent hair dye with a pointed applicator tip.
notes: A 250 ml bottle; as a liquid the whole bottle is one item, so the mass includes it. The reference is an abstract root that never spawns itself; its shades are their own drafts on this model, recoloured through the swatch slot. The root shows a brown swatch. CHECK VOLUME (x2.1): the box counts the air round the round bottle and nozzle.

name: Bottle of black hair dye
description: A squeeze bottle of black permanent hair dye.
notes: Rides on the hair_dye model with its swatch band in plastic-black; only the colour differs.

name: Jar of potassium
description: Soft grey lumps of potassium metal kept under mineral oil in a sealed jar. Reacts violently with water.
notes: The model is the jar a player picks up: glass, clear mineral oil, five grey lumps, black lid, yellow hazard label. A full jar is about the reference's 250 ml. Tiles draw the glass and oil opaque, which hides the lumps; they show in the game.

name: Jar of sodium
description: Soft silvery lumps of sodium metal kept under mineral oil in a sealed jar. Reacts violently with water.
notes: Shares the chem_potassium jar, recoloured with an orange label and paler lumps.
